--- pipe_as.sql
FROM Singers
|> AS s
|> WHERE s.FirstName = "John"

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 12,
            Name:    "Singers",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAs{
        Pipe:  13,
        Alias: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 19,
          NameEnd: 20,
          Name:    "s",
        },
      },
      &ast.PipeWhere{
        Pipe: 21,
        Expr: &ast.BinaryExpr{
          Op:   "=",
          Left: &ast.Path{
            Idents: []*ast.Ident{
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 30,
                NameEnd: 31,
                Name:    "s",
              },
              &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 32,
                NameEnd: 41,
                Name:    "FirstName",
              },
            },
          },
          Right: &ast.StringLiteral{
            ValuePos: 44,
            ValueEnd: 50,
            Value:    "John",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Singers |> AS s |> WHERE s.FirstName = "John"
